name: lower_hand_outscores_higher
counterintuitive: The Flush is the better poker hand and the worse play. A level 8 Pair (115 x 9) beats a level 1 Flush (35 x 4) by nearly 5x, because hand LEVEL dominates hand RANK once one hand has been levelled. An implementation that ranks by poker-hand strength instead of by computed score passes every other fixture and fails this one.
arithmetic: Pair at level 8 = 10 + 7*15 = 115 chips, 2 + 7*1 = 9 mult. Scoring cards AH(11) + AS(11) = 22. 137 x 9 = 1233. Flush at level 1 = 35 chips, 4 mult. Scoring cards AH(11) 5H(5) 8H(8) 9H(9) 2H(2) = 35. 70 x 4 = 280. The Pair wins 1233 to 280.
